archetypes.name: progress-gantt
archetypes.rationale: Active-round chart wiring spans label maps, timing windows, and detail fallback branches.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the progress_report.py in-flight Gantt paths for first-round and mixed-round states. Check window-start precedence, manifest-label precedence, row filtering, and skipped detail-renderer behavior when no completed round metadata exists. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: step3-resume-timing
archetypes.rationale: Postplan failure timing now runs on resumed phases and must not perturb non-terminal bail-outs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on review-design-step3-loop.sh failure paths. Verify timing is recorded only for the three terminal postplan-failed paths, uses persisted round-start-s when valid, and does not alter operator-required or main-agent-required envelopes. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
